tools.name: inventory-intelligence_data-normalize
tools.description: Copy supplied products, sales, supplier lead times, and purchases into a consistent inventory packet. Missing lead times and prices are not invented. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/inventory-intelligence/data-normalize. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: inventory-intelligence_stockout-risk-calculate
tools.description: Compare available stock with the calculated reorder point from supplied demand and lead times. Risk is not calculated when lead time or demand history is missing. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/inventory-intelligence/stockout-risk-calculate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not

tools.name: inventory-intelligence_reorder-point-calculate
tools.description: Calculate reorderPoint = averageDailyDemand × (leadTimeDays + reviewDays) + safetyStock from supplied history and lead times. No purchase order is created. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/inventory-intelligence/reorder-point-calculate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: inventory-intelligence_safety-stock-calculate
tools.description: Calculate safetyStock = serviceLevelZ × demandStdev × sqrt(leadTimeDays). Short history raises disclosed uncertainty. Seasonality is not invented. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/inventory-intelligence/safety-stock-calculate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: inventory-intelligence_excess-detect
tools.description: Flag SKUs whose days of cover from supplied on-hand and average daily demand exceed the disclosed excessDaysCover threshold. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/inventory-intelligence/excess-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: inventory-intelligence_slow-moving-stock-detect
tools.description: Flag SKUs whose supplied unit sales over the disclosed lookback are at or below the slowUnits threshold. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/inventory-intelligence/slow-moving-stock-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: inventory-intelligence_demand-forecast
tools.description: Forecast units as averageDailyDemand × forecastDays from available dated sales only. Seasonality is not modeled and uncertainty is disclosed. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/inventory-intelligence/demand-forecast. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: inventory-intelligence_optimization-report
tools.description: Combine stockout risk, reorder points, safety stock, excess, slow-moving stock, and demand forecasts from supplied data. No purchase order is created. Price $0.12 USDC. POST /api/v1/inventory-intelligence/optimization-report. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.
